text:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — draft for the launch journey + webinar drip is ready for review. Need final subject lines, segment rules, and owners for follow-up. Planning first touch next Tue morning. Outline pasted below. Thoughts?

Trent Alvarez: +1. Can we prioritize accounts that ran >100k tokens last 90d and haven't been sent cost-savings content? Those are our highest upside.

Jamie Patel: Agree. Also create a warm trialer segment: trial started in last 30d AND api_calls > 10. They'll get a lighter touch.

Olivia Morgan: Subject options — short list: 1) "See Redwood inference cost wins" 2) "Webinar: cut LLM inference cost in half" 3) "Live demo + benchmark — RSVP" Which two for A/B?

Maya Chen: A/B 1 vs 2 for opens. Keep 3 for invite-only/partners. @Trent can you own the segment export? @Jamie you take CTA/copy variants.

Trent Alvarez: I can do export. Will deliver CSV by EOD. Proposed segmentation logic (pseudo):
```
segment_high_value = accounts.filter(tokens_90d > 100000)
segment_warm_trial = accounts.filter(trial_start <= 30d && api_calls > 10)
segment_cold_but_active = accounts.filter(tokens_30d > 1000 && emails_opted_in)
```
Filter extras: exclude unsubscribed, exclude bounced.

Jamie Patel: Drafting two second-touch variants: (A) value-first — numbers from benchmark, (B) demo-first — migration path + quick start. Keeping CTAs consistent.

Maya Chen: Tracking & send windows: add UTM: utm_campaign=launch-journey-webinar&utm_medium=email. Send window: Tue/Thu 10-12 PT for trialers, Wed mornings for high-value.

CampaignBot: Draft saved to campaign workspace. Reminder set for QA 48h before send.

Olivia Morgan: For enterprise accounts let's prefix subject with "[Redwood Enterprise]" and customize preheader to mention SLA/dedicated.

Maya Chen: Ownership checklist: 1) Subject + preheader — Olivia 2) Segments + export — Trent 3) Copy + AB variants — Jamie 4) QA & test send — Maya. Timeline: drafts by tomorrow 12:00, tests by Friday COB.

Trent Alvarez: CSV columns I'll include: email, account_id, account_tier, last_api_call_ts, tokens_30d, tokens_90d, trial_start_ts, country. Filter: tokens_30d>100 OR (trial_start_ts <= 30d && api_calls>10).

Jamie Patel: CTAs planned: primary = "Reserve your spot" (signup), secondary = "Watch benchmark" (on-demand). I'll add experiment to swap button copy for 10% sample. Event to fire: "webinar_sign_up" with props: campaign, variant.

Maya Chen: Note — QA: check unsubscribe footer, tracking params, and mobile render. Also verify links point to production landing page.

CampaignBot: QA check: 2 broken links detected in draft_2.html.

Maya Chen: Thanks bot — fixing links now and will re-upload. If anyone sees issues after 3pm ping me directly.

Olivia Morgan: lgtm from design side — will send final subject suggestions in thread.

Trent Alvarez: Export queued. Will DM when ready.

Maya Chen: If no objections I'll lock the send window later today. :thumbsup:

Olivia Morgan: :raised_hands: good to go

CampaignBot: Reminder scheduled — send QA ping 48h before the scheduled send time.

Maya Chen: Awesome — thanks team.
